newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hershey Foods upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hershey Foods upgraded.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Chris Jakubik said Wednesday he upgraded his rating on Hershey Foods Corp to add from hold, citing an "underperformance" of the shares in recent months.
-- Hershey shares on Wednesday were down 1/8 at 44-1/8.
-- For 1997, Jakubik said he sees encouraging signs from Hershey's pasta and grocery segments, due in part to the best wheat price outlook in three years.
-- He also sees distribution savings for Hershey as it moves to a broker system.
-- "Concerns over the effectiveness and potential opportunities in the sugar/confectionary category prevented us from going to an all-out buy," Jakubik said.
-- On Tuesday, Hershey reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.51 a share, down from $0.68 a year ago. Earnings were down due to the sale of two overseas businesses.
-- Jakubik said earnings for the quarter were in line with expectations.
-- He continues to have an earnings estimate of $2.25 a share for 1997 and initiated an estimate of $2.50 for 1998.
